name: Sweep & reclaim (fade) at VWAP ± 2 standard deviations — price only (reference)
why: Stops cluster just beyond VWAP ± 2 standard deviations; aggressors who push through it and cannot hold beyond it (the 5-minute bar closes back inside) are trapped, and their exits plus the liquidity that absorbed them drive price back across the box. Pre-registered 2026-10-16 (research/preregistered/2026-10-16_liquidity_boxes_all.md). Reference run without the delta condition, 2010-26.

scan.when: vsd > 0 && ((hi(5,1) > lag(5, vwap + 2*vsd) && cl(5,1) < lag(5, vwap + 2*vsd)) || (lo(5,1) < lag(5, vwap - 2*vsd) && cl(5,1) > lag(5, vwap - 2*vsd)))
scan.dir: (lo(5,1) < lag(5, vwap - 2*vsd) && cl(5,1) > lag(5, vwap - 2*vsd)) - (hi(5,1) > lag(5, vwap + 2*vsd) && cl(5,1) < lag(5, vwap + 2*vsd))
